name: Illness-related resting heart rate change
description: Flags a resting heart rate well above the astronaut's own 28-day baseline, a change that often accompanies the onset of infections.
intended_use: Early, non-diagnostic prompt to re-check and report how the astronaut feels.
not_intended_for: Diagnosing COVID-19 or any illness; clinical decisions.

inputs.description: Daily resting heart rate (device value, or HR during inactivity).

outputs.z: robust z-score of today's resting HR vs the previous 28 days

datasets.name: Stanford smartwatch COVID-19 wearables
datasets.license: No explicit licence; public research release. Used for evaluation only, not redistributed.
datasets.citation: Mishra T. et al. Nat Biomed Eng 4, 1208-1220 (2020)
